verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents several local payment methods through its own APIs and hosted checkout: OPay e-wallets, M-Pesa, direct bank account charge, ACH, and bank-transfer virtual accounts. Its API flow also covers card, bank and other payment details. However, the evidence never mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay or BNPL, and it does not explicitly show all methods in a single checkout. missing for 10: Apple Pay support, Google Pay support, BNPL options, explicit bank-redirect flows, documentation that all methods are available through one checkout integration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Collect Mpesa payments from customers in Kenya.
Direct account charge allows you to collect payments directly from your customers’ bank accounts.
Create a hosted payment page and redirect your customer to it to pay.
Collect card, bank, and other payment details with your own UI, then charge the customer through the API.
